premise: Lying in the grass, Acorn sees a tree in the clouds, Bee sees a flower, and Caterpillar sees a butterfly: her own wish.
inspiration: Folk cloud-watching and Andersen's wishing, turned: each friend sees the thing they hope for, and the others promise to wait for it with her.

en-US.title: Cloud Shapes
en-US.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7 45s} {sfx:breeze} It was a lazy, cloudy afternoon. Acorn {acorn:pulse}, Caterpillar and Bee lay on their backs in the soft grass and looked up. [curious] What can you see? asked Bee. Acorn pointed. That one looks like a tree! A big, tall oak. {acorn:sparkle} Bee {bee:float loop 0.3} buzzed. [giggles] That one looks like a flower, with a bee on top! Caterpillar didn't say anything. She just looked and looked at one small cloud with two round wings. [softly] What's that one? asked Acorn. That one, said Caterpillar quietly, looks like a butterfly. {caterpillar:glow} Maybe one day, that will be me. [happily] Bee and Acorn {bee:hearts} {acorn:hearts} snuggled close. We'll wait for it with you, they said. And they watched the clouds until the sky turned gold.

es-ES.title: Formas de nubes
es-ES.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7 45s} {sfx:breeze} Era una tarde tranquila y nublada. Bellota {acorn:pulse}, Oruga y Abeja estaban tumbadas en la hierba blandita, mirando hacia arriba. [curious] ¿Qué veis?, preguntó Abeja. Bellota señaló. ¡Esa parece un árbol! Un roble grande y alto. {acorn:sparkle} Abeja {bee:float loop 0.3} zumbó. [giggles] ¡Esa parece una flor, con una abeja encima! Oruga no decía nada. Solo miraba y miraba una nube pequeñita con dos alas redondas. [softly] ¿Y esa qué es?, preguntó Bellota. Esa, dijo Oruga bajito, parece una mariposa. {caterpillar:glow} A lo mejor un día seré yo. [happily] Abeja y Bellota {bee:hearts} {acorn:hearts} se acurrucaron a su lado. Esperaremos contigo, dijeron. Y miraron las nubes hasta que el cielo se volvió dorado.
